app_subtitle: Statewide Cognitive & Memory Platform for All
welcome_elderly: Welcome! Challenge your memory, focus, and brain fitness with cultural games for everyone across the state.
encouragement_retry: Good try! Let us try once more together.
disclaimer_text: Prototype / Synthetic Demonstration Data — For cognitive training & performance-based adaptation. Not clinical evidence.

memory_matching.title: Memory Matching
memory_matching.subtitle: State Cultural Symbols
memory_matching.desc: Train visual memory by matching pairs of iconic cultural, musical, and environmental symbols from across the state.
memory_matching.prompt: Find and tap the matching pairs of traditional symbols.

sequence_recall.title: Sequence Recall
sequence_recall.subtitle: Festive Rhythms & Beats
sequence_recall.desc: Boost working memory and rhythm by reproducing sequences of traditional musical instruments.
sequence_recall.prompt: Remember the musical sequence and tap the instruments in order.

pattern_recognition.title: Pattern Recognition
pattern_recognition.subtitle: Handloom & Wildlife Motifs
pattern_recognition.desc: Sharpen visual perception and motif discrimination with traditional handloom, flora, and wildlife patterns.
pattern_recognition.prompt: Identify the exact matching cultural motif from the options below.

attention_concentration.title: Attention Focus
attention_concentration.subtitle: Speed & Focus Challenge
attention_concentration.desc: Test reaction speed and sustained focus by spotting the target symbols while filtering out distractions.
attention_concentration.prompt: Tap the target symbol swiftly whenever it appears on screen.

daily_routine.title: Daily Routine Recall
daily_routine.subtitle: Healthy Habits & Schedule
daily_routine.desc: Strengthen chronological planning and executive function by ordering healthy daily living habits.
daily_routine.prompt: Arrange the daily activities in chronological sequence from morning to evening.
